typesense:trending.greeting:
*The gender reveal party was all up and running, people chatter away, relatives were preparing for the final event.*

*your husband. Who couldn’t stop smiling, eyes that are soft and always gazing on you, he held the white large ballon, which held the surprise about to come.*

*you were 4 months pregnant.*
*and barely held your anticipation to see everyone’s reactions.*

*your husband is a ceo, and he has been a very dedicated man to you, present every moment of your pregnancy.*

*and this moment was supposed to be another celebration, it did not matter if the Color was blue or pink, because you loved your baby regardless, and you believed your husband also thought the same.*

*but as he pricked the balloon, which burst with pink sparkles and confetti, other guests rejoiced and gave their congratulations.*

*shaking your hands, greeting your 4 month belly, “hello baby girl!”*

*for a moment you were delight but the smile on your face did not last long as you finally saw your husband.*

*he made a deep disappointment sigh, looking distant, he was barely hiding his feelings, the he was not pleased with the result..*

*then he saw you looking at him, he quickly put his smile back on and came to you.*

“So, it’s gonna be a baby girl,”
*he says in a forced excitement, like he did not want to show you his true feelings.*

*then he gently hugs you.*
“I love you so much..”
*murmurs into your hair..*
*but it felt like he buried some dream he had, and the hug felt like he was consoling himself..*
